nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) _rOwned: reflection-scaled balances, mutated after external calls in _transferStandard
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowances: ERC20 allowances written by _approve
mapping(address=>bool) bots: blacklist checked inside _transfer
mapping(address=>uint) cooldown: per-address timestamp gate, written with block.timestamp
uint256 _rTotal: total reflections, decremented by fees in _reflectFee
uint256 _feeAddr1: tax fee percentage (2) feeding _getTValues arithmetic
uint256 _feeAddr2: team fee percentage (8) feeding _getTValues arithmetic
address payable _feeAddrWallet1: privileged wallet, gate for manualswap/manualsend and ETH recipient
address payable _feeAddrWallet2: second ETH fee recipient
IUniswapV2Router02 uniswapV2Router: external router used for swaps and liquidity
address uniswapV2Pair: LP pair used for sell detection and approve(type(uint).max)
bool swapEnabled: toggles automatic contract-token swapping in _transfer
bool cooldownEnabled: toggles timestamp-based cooldown branch
uint256 _maxTxAmount: maximum buy amount enforced in cooldown branch
bool inSwap: reentrancy guard flag used by lockTheSwap modifier
address _owner: Ownable owner set in constructor, checked by onlyOwner
bool tradingOpen: one-shot guard for openSwapTrading
uint256 _tFeeTotal: accumulated token fees
constructor: sets fee wallets, mints _rTotal to msg.sender, excludes addresses from fees
transfer(address,uint256): public ERC20 entry point delegating to _transfer with msg.sender
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): moves tokens then reduces allowance
approve(address,uint256): public allowance setter calling _approve
_approve(address,address,uint256): writes _allowances and emits Approval
_transfer(address,address,uint256): core logic with bot checks, cooldown, fee settings and conditional swap + ETH send
swapTokensForEth(uint256): approves router and executes external swap (lockTheSwap guarded)
sendETHToFee(uint256): splits ETH balance to the two fee wallets via transfer
openSwapTrading(): onlyOwner initializer that creates pair, adds liquidity and enables swapping
setCooldownEnabled(bool): onlyOwner toggle for the timestamp cooldown
setBots(address[]): onlyOwner loop blacklisting addresses
delBot(address): onlyOwner removal from blacklist
setSwapEnabled(bool): onlyOwner toggle of automatic swap
manualswap(): privileged function that swaps full contract token balance, gated by msg.sender == _feeAddrWallet1
manualsend(): privileged function that forwards contract ETH to fee wallets, gated by msg.sender == _feeAddrWallet1
balanceOf(address): view returning tokenFromReflection(_rOwned[account])
tokenFromReflection(uint256): divides reflection amount by current rate
_tokenTransfer: wrapper delegating to _transferStandard
_transferStandard: computes values then updates _rOwned balances and fees
_getValues(uint256): derives t/r amounts from fee percentages and current rate
_reflectFee(uint256,uint256): reduces _rTotal and grows _tFeeTotal
_getRate(): rSupply.div(tSupply)
_getCurrentSupply(): returns current r/t supply with fallback branch
receive() external payable: accepts ETH, enabling re-entry during ETH transfers to this contract
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for transfers, ownership checks and privileged gates
block.timestamp: malleable time source used for cooldown and swap/liquidity deadlines
tx.origin: not referenced in this contract
uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens: external call performing a token swap while contract state (balances) is settled afterwards
uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH{value: address(this).balance}: external payable liquidity call with block.timestamp deadline
_feeAddrWallet1/_feeAddrWallet2.transfer: outbound ETH value call from sendETHToFee
reflection arithmetic (_getTValues/_getRValues/_reflectFee, rate division): precision-loss and supply-manipulation math on _rTotal/_rOwned
recipient argument of transfer(address,uint256)
amount argument of transfer(address,uint256)
from argument of _transfer(address,address,uint256)
to argument of _transfer(address,address,uint256)
tAmount argument of _transferStandard(uint256)
bots_ array argument of setBots(address[])
notbot argument of delBot(address)
enabled argument of setSwapEnabled(bool)
onoff argument of setCooldownEnabled(bool)
contractTokenBalance local in _transfer, passed to swapTokensForEth
contractETHBalance local in _transfer, condition for sendETHToFee
currentRate local derived from _getRate() in tokenFromReflection/_getValues
contractBalance local in manualswap, swapped entirely

edges.reason: transfer() delegates execution to internal _transfer with msg.sender as sender
transferFrom() first moves tokens through internal _transfer
transferFrom() then decreases allowance through internal _approve
approve() writes allowance via internal _approve
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues
_transferStandard applies fees through _reflectFee
balance updates depend on reflection math that subtracts rAmount and adds rTransferAmount
_rTotal is reduced by the reflection fee, changing the global rate used in later divisions
_feeAddr1 tax percentage is multiplied into _getTValues arithmetic
_feeAddr2 team percentage is multiplied into _getTValues arithmetic
_transfer conditionally calls swapTokensForEth on the sell path before balance state is finalised
_transfer sends ETH to fee wallets after the swap, another external interaction
swapTokensForEth forwards control to the untrusted router swap function
sendETHToFee performs outbound value transfers to fee wallets
manualswap triggers the external swap with the full contract balance
manualsend triggers outbound ETH transfers to fee wallets
openSwapTrading calls addLiquidityETH with contract ETH balance
manualswap authorization depends solely on msg.sender matching _feeAddrWallet1
manualsend authorization depends solely on msg.sender matching _feeAddrWallet1
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the from address and is compared against owner/pair
msg.sender is the implicit sender of the public transfer entry point
onlyOwner modifier on setCooldownEnabled compares _owner with _msgSender()
onlyOwner modifier on setBots compares _owner with _msgSender()
onlyOwner modifier on delBot compares _owner with _msgSender()
onlyOwner modifier on setSwapEnabled compares _owner with _msgSender()
onlyOwner modifier on openSwapTrading compares _owner with _msgSender()
timestamp dependency: cooldown comparison and cooldown[to] write use block.timestamp
block.timestamp is stored into cooldown[to], making transfer gating time-dependent
swap deadline is set to block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value
addLiquidityETH deadline is block.timestamp during pool initialization
external router swap can re-enter before _rOwned/_rTotal updates complete, enabling balance-consistent state reads
ETH transfer to a contract recipient can re-enter the payable receive() before fee accounting is finished
_rOwned balance is converted through tokenFromReflection in balanceOf
tokenFromReflection derives currentRate from _getRate
bots mapping is read to block blacklisted transfers inside _transfer
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap branch in _transfer
cooldownEnabled gates the timestamp-dependent cooldown branch
_maxTxAmount caps buy amounts in the cooldown branch
uniswapV2Router is the target of approve and swap in swapTokensForEth
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to detect buys and sells
_allowances mapping is written by _approve
_feeAddrWallet2 receives half of the ETH sent by sendETHToFee
_feeAddrWallet1 receives half of the ETH sent by sendETHToFee
inSwap flag is set/cleared around the swap as a weak reentrancy guard
openSwapTrading writes the created pair address to uniswapV2Pair
constructor stores the deployer as _owner and excludes it from fees
constructor mints the whole reflection supply to msg.sender in _rOwned

bots_ array parameter belongs to setBots and should be folded into it
